name: Scinorx Click Tracker
author: Scinorx Technologies Inc

sections.description:
Scinorx Click Tracker is a lightweight WordPress plugin for small businesses that want to understand which important website actions visitors are taking.

The plugin tracks website link clicks automatically without requiring a complicated analytics setup. It reads each link’s visible text, title, or aria-label and creates a simple tracking tag for reporting.

It is useful for service businesses, local businesses, consultants, agencies, clinics, and WordPress website owners who want a simple way to monitor calls, emails, quote buttons, booking links, and other key website CTAs.

What you can track

  • Phone links such as tel:
  • Email links such as mailto:
  • Call-to-action links and buttons
  • External links
  • Download links
  • Normal website links when automatic tracking is enabled

Features

  • Automatic site-wide link click tracking
  • Automatic phone click tracking
  • Automatic email click tracking
  • Automatic click type detection
  • Automatic tracking tag generation from link text/title/aria-label
  • Recent clicks dashboard
  • Click totals by type
  • Source page tracking
  • CSV export
  • Simple settings page
  • Optional uninstall cleanup

Shortcode

The plugin works automatically. You can also use this shortcode to create a tracked button with an optional custom tag:

[scxct_click_button url="tel:+19195551234" label="Call Now" type="phone" tag="phone-header"]

Supported types:

  • phone
  • email
  • cta
  • download
  • external
  • other
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the plugin zip from WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Click Tracker in the WordPress dashboard.
  4. Visit the Click Tracker dashboard to see tracked clicks and automatically generated tags.
sections.faq:
Does this replace Google Analytics?

No. Scinorx Click Tracker is a simple WordPress dashboard tool for tracking important website clicks. It can be used alongside analytics platforms.

Does it track phone and email links automatically?

Yes. Phone and email tracking are enabled by default and can be turned off in plugin settings.

Do I need to manually tag every link?

No. Automatic tracking is enabled by default. The plugin reads link text, title, or aria-label values and generates tracking tags for you.

Can I still use custom tags?

Yes. Developers can optionally use data-scxct-click-tag, but this is not required for normal use.

Does the plugin store personal data?

The plugin stores click event details such as target URL, source URL, label, tracking tag, click type, and date. It does not store visitor IP addresses and does not send click data to Scinorx. Site owners should review their privacy policy and disclose click tracking where required.
